name: Qwen3 Embedding 4B on the Radeon 680M (Embrandt)
summary: Qwen3-Embedding-4B Q8_0 on an AMD Radeon 680M integrated GPU through Vulkan, served by the Embrandt engine: about twice as fast as llama.cpp with identical embeddings. Installed on demand, not kept warm.

license.name: Recipe metadata only; Qwen3-Embedding-4B is Apache-2.0 and Embrandt is AGPL-3.0-only

provenance.source: Enntity/embrandt 0cf190be8e538597e8487a0b3e90ee9163d7820c; Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-4B-GGUF f4602530db1d980e16da9d7d3a70294cf5c190be. Measured on a Ryzen 7 PRO 6850U with Mesa 25.2.8 on 2026-11-22: 168 ms at 128 tokens and 609 ms at 488, against 322 and 1,248 ms for llama.cpp b12606, every vector identical.

hardware.testedMachine: Ryzen 7 PRO 6850U mini PC, Ubuntu 24.04, Mesa 25.2.8 RADV.
notes: The engine's fast paths are written for the Radeon 680M (PCI device 0x1681); nothing else is tested.
About 8 GB of system memory while loaded. One forward pass at a time: about 15 short or 6 128-token sequences per second.
The build needs git, cmake, ninja, g++, glslc and the Vulkan and SPIR-V headers; Mesa's RADV driver must be installed.
Embeddings are Q8_0. Do not mix them in one index with vectors from a BF16 server of the same model without checking retrieval.

steps.title: Build the Embrandt engine and download the pinned Q8_0 GGUF
